fact.quote: If your application is returned for change or to fill incomplete details, kindly submit it within 14 days of return. If fail to submit within 14 days application will be disposed with rejection. Application fee will not be refunded.

fact.quote: In case of any wrong/misleading information provided in application shall lead to rejection of the application by Department Authorities.
